summary: The dashboard demonstrates clean composition and typography adhering to the design system, with minor vertical alignment inconsistencies in radio list items.

issues.title: Radio button vertical misalignment
issues.description: Radio inputs are centered across multiline labels instead of top-aligning with primary label text.
issues.evidence: Radio circles in 'Hourly', 'Daily', and 'Weekly' sit at varying vertical baselines relative to primary titles.
issues.suggestion: Align radio indicators to the top line or baseline of the item title.
